ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the source report was ingested into the system

reportName.description: Name of the source report file the record was extracted from

reportFolder.description: Source folder or path where the report file was collected

mission.description: Mission code derived from the report Mission header (Earth_Explorer_Header/Fixed_Header/Mission)

satellite_id.description: Satellite identifier derived from the report Mission header (Earth_Explorer_Header/Fixed_Header/Mission)

station_id.description: Ground station identifier of the acquisition (StationAcquisitionReport/StationId)

antenna_id.description: Identifier of the antenna used for the downlink (StationDownlinkDetails/AntennaId)

downlink_start_time.description: Start time of the downlink pass (StationDownlinkDetails/DownlinkStartTime)

downlink_end_time.description: End time of the downlink pass (StationDownlinkDetails/DownlinkEndTime)

downlink_orbit.description: Orbit number during which the downlink occurred (Variable_Header/Downlink_Orbit)

comments.description: Free-text comments from the station acquisition report (StationDownlinkDetails/Comments)

fer_downlink.description: Frame Error Rate reported for the downlink (FEP_Information/FER_Downlink)

fer_data.description: Frame Error Rate reported for the data (FEP_Information/FER_Data)

interface_name.description: Name of the collector interface that produced this record, set to AcqPassesStatusEDS

production_service_type.description: Type of the production service that provided the report, set to EDS

production_service_name.description: Name of the production service that provided the report, set to CGS
